author: KEXP
description: Portland, Oregon-based singer-songwriter Alela Diane flexes her storytelling skills on her latest release 'Who's Keeping Time?' Filling the KEXP Live Room with enchanting vocals and layered instrumentation, she offers a performance of "In My Own Time" and more.
title: Alela Diane performs "In My Own Time" & more Live on KEXP
